title: Cheap Toys
text: There were several bags of different treats. Yogi enjoyed all of them. But, the 2 toys sent we're not suitable for a 65lb. Pitbull. Yogi made quick work of destroying them. The stuffing is nylon/puffy/cotton. Dangerous if swallowed. I cannot give this more than 3 stars on that issue. It is worth the subscription price of 39.99. The toys need to be size-related. The toys Yogi received were for a small (5lbs-15lbs) dog.
label: neutral
